cases.translation: my soul is in great turmoil

reading.ru: Помилуй меня, Господи, ведь я изможден.
reading.question: What is the condition of the psalmist as described in this verse?
reading.explain: The psalmist says я изможден (I am faint/exhausted), asking God for mercy due to his weak condition.

reading.ru: Исцели меня, Господи, так как дрожь пробирает меня до костей.
reading.question: What physical ailment is the psalmist experiencing?
options: Tremors running through his body to the bones
reading.correct: Tremors running through his body to the bones
reading.explain: The text describes дрожь пробирает меня до костей (a tremor runs through me to the bones).

reading.ru: Ведь в смерти нет памяти о Тебе.
reading.question: According to this verse, what is true about death?
options: There is no memory of God in death
reading.correct: There is no memory of God in death
reading.explain: The psalmist states в смерти нет памяти о Тебе (in death there is no memory of You).

reading.ru: Я устал стенать. Каждую ночь моя постель влажна от слез.
reading.question: How does the psalmist describe his nightly distress?
options: His bed is wet from tears each night
reading.correct: His bed is wet from tears each night
reading.explain: The text says Каждую ночь моя постель влажна от слез (Every night my bed is wet from tears).

reading.ru: Прочь от меня, все творящие зло!
reading.question: What does the psalmist command the evildoers to do?
reading.explain: The psalmist says Прочь от меня (Depart/Away from me) to all who do evil.

reading.question: What has the Lord done according to this verse?
reading.explain: The verse states Господь услышал мою мольбу (The Lord heard my supplication/plea).
